title: Plumeform feature rows (v2)
description: Airy alternating rows on paper: an eyebrow, a heavy two-line heading and a slate paragraph (optionally bullets with teal dots) beside a near-white glass panel floating in pastel fog. Rows sit far apart and swap sides; on phones the text comes first and the panel follows, slightly inset. An optional centred line and underlined link opens the section. Text and panels fade, rise and un-blur into view; the fog drifts with the scroll.
notes: each row's panel takes any node (a demo, a screenshot, a form); empty, it is a placeholder of panelHeight
the first row puts its text on the left; set startWith="panel" to flip the order
